title: Class update: 11 to 14 November
headline: Class update
caption:
Class update for this week 🧡

Due to a family emergency, all classes are cancelled tomorrow (Wednesday 11 November) and on Thursday 12 November.

On Friday 13 and Saturday 14 November, Sarah will be taking our Reformer classes, which will run as scheduled.

If you're booked into a cancelled class, your booking will be refunded and your credit returned.

I'm so sorry for the short notice, and thank you for your understanding. I'll share another update as soon as I can, including when the other classes will resume.

Caroline x

You can book Reformer Pilates in Clitheroe through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
source: One-off class update requested by Jake on 2026-11-10; not from the content calendar.
